query:
UPDATE score_card_skips SET (id, 
scorer_account_id, 
target_account_id, 
reason, 
created_at) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE scorer_account_id END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE target_account_id END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE reason END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE created_at END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
scorer_account_id as "scorer_account_id!: String", 
target_account_id as "target_account_id!: String", 
reason as "reason!: String", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime"
